sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Brennius is a cross reference. The book sends the reader to Belenus. Belenus was a Continental Celtic god. The spring festival of Beltane may take its name from him. The Romans compared him to Apollo. Believers honored him at healing waters such as Aquae Borvonis in France. The healing plant Belinuntia carries his name.

okr.objective: Route the reader from Brennius to the god Belenus.
